title: Form Energy media placeholder
description: A flat token-coloured surface that stands in for a photo or video until real media fills the slot: a soft diagonal from the muted tone to a faint ink wash, or a dark one for photo bands under white text.
notes: fills its parent; give the parent the size, radius and aspect ratio
name: formenergy-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: light: muted to a faint ink wash (photos on light bands) · dark: a deep grey diagonal (photo bands under white text)

props.name: className
props.description: size and position of the slot it fills
